title: Fynaptix · Defense Tech Research
heading: Defense Technology Intelligence
subheading: AI battlefield software, drones, autonomy & European rearmament
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Defense names carry policy, program-concentration, and valuation risk. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Europe & Canada added $90B+ in 2021-price terms in 2025 (~20% YoY, NATO update); 5 Allies now expected to hit the 3.5% core-defense guideline in 2026 and 17 Allies the 1.5% broader-investment guideline, on the path to NATO's 5%-of-GDP-by-2035 pledge

Defense tech VC funding hit a new full-year record in barely five months (Crunchbase); Anduril's targeted $100B round remains unclosed more than five weeks after first being reported (Jul 24), alongside megarounds already closed by Shield AI, Saronic and Helsing

Defense Autonomous Warfare Group request, a ~24,000% jump from FY26's $225M, inside a record $75B FY27 drone/counter-drone budget ask; a CCA Increment 2 downselect to as few as 6 of 20+ eligible vendors remains open per July Industry Days remarks — Kratos remains excluded from Increment 1

Tariffs up to 100% on imported drones >25kg or with thermal imaging (25% on smaller drones/components; 15% for EU, Japan, Switzerland, Taiwan, South Korea, Liechtenstein) take effect within days — a structural tailwind for domestic makers AVAV, RCAT, ONDS and KTOS, though the small-cap drone complex gave back much of its August gains this week (Aug 20 & 28 selloffs) as 30-year Treasury yields near 19-year highs pressured high-multiple names

private_watchlist.name: Anduril
private_watchlist.note: Talks first reported Jul 24 remain unclosed more than five weeks later, as of Aug 31 — the proposed round would be more than 3x the $30.5B mark from just over a year ago and up from the $61B May 2026 round (Thrive Capital, a16z). One floated structure would commit investors now to a second, higher-priced raise within about a year if Anduril hits financial benchmarks. CEO has separately warned it's "bad to IPO in the middle of a hype cycle."

private_watchlist.name: Shield AI
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $2B Series G (Mar 26, 2026) co-led by Advent International and JPMorgan's Security & Resiliency Initiative, plus $500M in non-dilutive preferred equity from Blackstone. Continuing to compete for a Navy ISR task-order pool worth up to $800M using the V-BAT drone.

private_watchlist.name: Saronic
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; continuing to scale its NVIDIA-powered autonomy stack and its Franklin, Louisiana shipyard (part of a $300M expansion) toward a stated target of 20+ autonomous surface vessels a year by 2027. Still marked by the $1.75B Series D led by Kleiner Perkins.

private_watchlist.name: Helsing
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $1.8B round closed Jul 13, 2026 (JPMorgan, Lightspeed, Iconiq). AI software + strike drones, Europe's rearmament wave.

bear_case.title: Public-market valuations still elevated
bear_case.description: The US Aerospace & Defense industry continues to trade well above historical multiples. Palantir has climbed to ~$186.29 (Aug 28) on raised price targets, yet Cathie Wood trimmed $27.2M of PLTR in August even as the stock rises — a reminder that conviction is far from unanimous at these prices.

bear_case.title: Rate-driven rotation is hitting high-multiple small caps hard
bear_case.description: 30-year Treasury yields near 19-year highs have twice this month triggered a coordinated 'drone trade unwind' across the small-cap complex — Aug 20 (Ondas -7%, Kratos -5%) and again Aug 28 (Unusual Machines -9%, Ondas -6%, Red Cat -5%) — with no company-specific news behind either move. Kratos is now down ~20% YTD despite two guidance raises this summer.

bear_case.title: Winning a contract doesn't guarantee funding follows through
bear_case.description: Golden Dome's own program chief warned in mid-August the shield could halt as early as October without new congressional appropriation — Congress funded FY2026 through reconciliation rather than the base budget, and a continuing resolution would leave FY2027 with no baseline — despite L3Harris and Sierra Space just banking $1.75B combined in fresh missile-tracking satellite awards.

bear_case.title: Governance and program-execution risk hits even established primes
bear_case.description: Two weeks after L3Harris ousted CEO Chris Kubasik with no further explanation offered, the uncertainty remains unresolved, and Rheinmetall's F126 frigate cancellation is still working through its FY26 guidance months later — proof that record backlogs don't insulate a prime from sudden leadership or program shocks.

catalysts.title: Drone-sector profit-taking outpaces a calm broader market
catalysts.description: Unusual Machines -9%, Ondas -6%, Red Cat -5% at midday while the S&P 500 rose ~0.4% — no company-specific news behind the move, consistent with a rate-driven rotation out of high-beta small caps.

catalysts.title: Rheinmetall wins €250M Lithuania modular-camp contract
catalysts.description: Contract to build housing for up to 2,000 German Armed Forces soldiers under the Bundeswehr's contractor programme; backlog now €80.5B.

catalysts.title: 'Drone trade unwind' then snapback across small-cap names
catalysts.description: Ondas -7%, Kratos -5% (Aug 20) reversed to Unusual Machines +7%, Ondas +4%, Kratos +3% (Aug 21) — a pure theme-rotation pattern rather than fundamental news.

catalysts.title: BAE Systems wins $169.2M MK41 VLS contract modification
catalysts.description: Vertical Launching System canister production combining US (53%), Australia (23%), Japan (13%) and Netherlands (11%) FMS purchases.

catalysts.title: L3Harris ousts CEO Chris Kubasik over conduct violation
catalysts.description: Board-directed investigation led to immediate removal; insider Sam Mehta named successor. Two weeks on, no further detail has been disclosed.

catalysts.title: Golden Dome program chief warns of October funding cliff
catalysts.description: Space Force Gen. Michael Guetlein said the $17.5B FY27 Golden Dome request could stall under a continuing resolution, even as $1.75B in fresh satellite contracts reach L3Harris and Sierra Space.

etfs.name: Global X Defense Tech
etfs.summary: Tilted toward Palantir and autonomy pure-plays, with almost 38% annualized returns since its Sept 2023 inception; this week's small-cap drone-sector volatility (Aug 20 & 28 selloffs) makes for a choppier short-term read than the cap-weighted primes indices, even as the long-run trend holds

etfs.name: iShares US Aerospace & Defense
etfs.summary: Largest in category at ~$13.3B AUM; broad US primes exposure was largely insulated from this week's small-cap drone volatility; 0.38% expense ratio

etfs.name: Invesco Aerospace & Defense
etfs.summary: ~11% YTD in 2026, ~29% over the trailing year; US-focused, adds commercial aerospace (Boeing, GE Aerospace, RTX); trades at a lower P/E (~27x) than ITA (~31x)

etfs.name: Select STOXX Europe Defense

positions.name: BAE Systems
positions.note: Shares were untouched by this week's small-cap drone-sector volatility (Aug 20 & 28 selloffs) — the £84B backlog, Aug 18 $169.2M MK41 mod and Storm Fighter/Brontanax progress keep the thesis intact; still the most straightforward name for you to hold, UK-listed with no wrapper needed.

positions.name: AeroVironment

Also sits in the Robotics sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

Also sits in the Space sleeve via its satellite work — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.note: New Aug 25 €250M Lithuania camp contract pushes the backlog to €80.5B, but the stock has drifted down to €1,154.60 (Aug 28), near the bottom of its post-guidance-cut range — order wins haven't yet stabilized the shares, so this stays a watch; directly accessible from the UK without a US wrapper.

Also anchors the AI sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.
